findings.detail: Two assigned generation credential roots now use controller config version 2. Historical survival current hashes remain recorded verbatim; baseline and actual canonical bytes/hashes are preserved. Identity/obligation retained, no retirement credit.

qualification_limits: SOURCE_ONLY_CANDIDATE; runtime UNKNOWN_NO_RECEIPTS_REVIEWED_NO_EXECUTION; no build, tests, crypto operations, helpers or live services executed.
Real Vault boundary is local filesystem only; bundle reader is synthetic, no OCI Vault SDK or cloud boundary credit.
Function TLS handshake uses stdlib httptest server with test-owned URI verifier; production issuer is reached, production function server/Wasm runtime is not.
Generated credential setup files are incidental to direct local grant validation; generationtest material callbacks are map-backed, not disk readers.
No crash/power-loss durability, live provider identity, production installation, deployment or runtime pass/fail claimed.
All safety, refusal, binding, scope, expiry, no-overwrite, partial-write, secret protection, no-fetch and retry obligations retained.
